what_it_is: Ceinsys Tech Limited (CS TECH Ai) is a Nagpur-based, NSE/BSE-listed geospatial and engineering-services company with CMMI Level 5 appraisal, delivering GIS platforms, digital-twin and engineering solutions to Indian central/state agencies and defence-adjacent users. It is one of the few listed pure-play Indian geospatial firms.
india_angle: Ceinsys' listing and public-sector project base make it a verifiable Indian geospatial supplier; its military-aerospace relevance lies in terrain intelligence, command-and-control GIS backends and drone-data pipelines rather than hardware. Watch defence survey and C4ISR-adjacent awards in its exchange filings.
intelligence_assessment: As a listed company, Ceinsys' contract flow is auditable through Indian exchange disclosures - unusually strong verifiability for this segment. Specific defence programme attribution remains sparse in public materials.
sites: Nagpur Nagpur, Maharashtra Indicative Precision machined parts; engineering design services; tooling. Tier-2 / Tier-3 supplier to Airbus.
